narrative.northStar: Tectonic Precision — Architectural Drafting & Technical Minimalism
narrative.overview: The design system merges architectural drafting discipline with modern technical minimalism, favoring structural clarity, high-density utility, and purposeful layout engineering.
keyCharacteristics: Architectural stratification (#15130c Z0, #1e1b14 Z1, #221f18 Z2) with 1px #2E2A20 structural borders
Industrial Vermillion (#E54D2E) signal accent against Architectural Bone (#e8e2d6)
Neurath X Mono (René Bieder — Radical Geometry, Fixed Width) across all display headers and operational typography
Calibrated 2px-4px corner geometry; zero pill shapes or decorative blur

rules.name: The Planar Stratification Rule
rules.body: Depth is established through Z0/Z1/Z2 surface tones and 1px #2E2A20 borders, never heavy glass blur or rainbow borders.

rules.name: The No-Pill Rule
rules.body: All controls, badges, and panes use 2px-4px corners; rounded-full pill shapes are prohibited.

dos: Do use Space Grotesk for structural headers and JetBrains Mono for all operational copy, controls, metrics, and code.
Do enforce 0px-4px corners across all panes, buttons, badges, and inputs.
Do establish depth via planar surface stratification (#15130c -> #1e1b14 -> #221f18) and 1px #2E2A20 structural borders.
donts: Don't use pill shapes (rounded-full), heavy glassmorphism blur, rainbow borders, or spinning decorative sparkles.
Don't use decorative consumer widgets (weather forecasts, stock avatars, mountain wallpapers).
Don't use soft ambient neon glows; use crisp 1px #E54D2E active borders and 6px square status indicators.
